questions.stem: What is the probability of the empty set φ according to the axiomatic approach?
questions.solution: According to the axiomatic approach, the probability of the empty set φ is 0. This follows from the third axiom of probability, which states that if E and F are mutually exclusive events, then P(E ∪ F) = P(E) + P(F). By taking F = φ, we can deduce that P(φ) = 0. The other options are incorrect because they contradict the axiomatic definition.

hi.stem: अक्षांशीय दृष्टिकोण के अनुसार खाली सेट φ की प्रायिकता क्या है?
hi.solution: अक्षांशीय दृष्टिकोण के अनुसार, खाली सेट φ की प्रायिकता 0 होती है। यह द्वितीय अक्षांश के आधार पर होता है, जो कहता है कि यदि E और F अपवर्जी कार्य हैं, तो P(E ∪ F) = P(E) + P(F)। F = φ लेकर हम P(φ) = 0 के निष्कर्ष पर पहुंच सकते हैं। अन्य विकल्प अक्षांशीय परिभाषा के विरोधी हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms. The solution correctly identifies option (2) as the answer.

mr.solution: अभिकल्पीय पद्धतीनुसार, φ रिक्त समुच्चयाची संभाव्यता 0 आहे. याचे कारण तिसऱ्या अभिकल्पाचे आहे, जे म्हणते की जर E आणि F अनुवर्ती घटना असतील, तर P(E ∪ F) = P(E) + P(F). F = φ घेऊन, आपण P(φ) = 0 चे निष्कर्ष काढू शकतो. इतर विकल्प अभिकल्पीय विधानाच्या विरुद्ध आहेत.

questions.stem: What is the probability of getting a number less than 6 when a die is rolled?
questions.solution: The total number of outcomes when a die is rolled is 6 (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6). The numbers less than 6 are 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5, which gives 5 favorable outcomes. So, the probability is 5/6. The option 1/6 is incorrect because it counts only one favorable outcome. The option 1/2 is incorrect because it assumes only 3 favorable outcomes. The option 2/3 is incorrect because it assumes 4 favorable outcomes.

questions.stem: If a coin is tossed, what is the probability of getting a head?

questions.stem: A box contains 10 red marbles, 20 blue marbles and 30 green marbles. 5 marbles are drawn from the box. What is the probability that all will be blue?
questions.solution: The total number of marbles is 10 + 20 + 30 = 60. The number of ways to choose 5 blue marbles from 20 is C(20,5). The total number of ways to choose 5 marbles from 60 is C(60,5). The probability that all 5 marbles will be blue is C(20,5)/C(60,5). The option C(20,5)/C(50,5) is incorrect because it uses 50 instead of 60 as the total number of marbles. The option C(20,5)/C(30,5) is incorrect because it uses 30 instead of 60. The option C(20,5)/C(40,5) is incorrect because it uses 40 instead of 60.

questions.stem: If A and B are two events such that A ∩ B = φ, which of the following statements is true?
choices: A and B are mutually exclusive
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'A and B are mutually exclusive' because if the intersection of A and B is an empty set, it means there are no outcomes common to both events. 'A and B are independent' is incorrect because mutual exclusivity does not imply independence. 'A and B are exhaustive' is false because exhaustive events must cover the entire sample space. 'A and B are dependent' is also incorrect as mutual exclusivity does not imply dependence.

questions.stem: In a sample space of 10 outcomes, an event E has 3 outcomes. What is the probability of the event E not occurring?
questions.solution: The probability of an event occurring is the number of favorable outcomes divided by the total number of outcomes. Here, the probability of event E occurring is 3/10. The probability of event E not occurring is the complement of this, which is 1 - 3/10 = 7/10. The other options are incorrect: 1/10 would be the probability of a single outcome, 3/10 is the probability of E occurring, and 9/10 would be the probability of E not occurring if there were only 1 favorable outcome for E.

hi.solution: किसी घटना के होने की प्रायिकता अनुकूल परिणामों की संख्या को कुल परिणामों की संख्या से विभाजित करके प्राप्त की जाती है। यहां, घटना E के होने की प्रायिकता 3/10 है। घटना E के नहीं होने की प्रायिकता इसके पूरक होती है, जो 1 - 3/10 = 7/10 है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं: 1/10 एक एकल परिणाम की प्रायिकता होगी, 3/10 E के होने की प्रायिकता है, और 9/10 E के नहीं होने की प्रायिकता होगी यदि E के केवल 1 अनुकूल परिणाम होते।

questions.stem: Two events A and B are such that P(A) = 0.5, P(B) = 0.6, and P(A ∩ B) = 0.3. What is the probability of A ∪ B?
questions.solution: The probability of A ∪ B is calculated using the formula P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B). Substituting the given values, 0.5 + 0.6 - 0.3 = 0.8. The other options are incorrect because 0.9 is the probability of A ∪ B if P(A ∩ B) was 0.2, 1.0 is the probability of a certain event, and 1.1 is not a valid probability as it exceeds 1.
